title: Streaming Module
summary: This module provides functionality to enable incremental streaming of DSPy program outputs, allowing for real-time feedback and custom processing of streamed content. It includes utilities for wrapping programs, processing field-specific streams, and formatting outputs for API responses.

nodes.label: DSPy Program
nodes.title: DSPy Program Input
nodes.description: The DSPy program (Module) to be wrapped for streaming output, typically a dspy.Module instance.

nodes.label: Wrap Program for Streaming
nodes.title: streamify
nodes.description: Transforms a DSPy program to yield outputs incrementally, supporting status messages and custom listeners for fine-grained control over streaming content.

nodes.label: LLM Response Stream
nodes.title: Raw LLM Stream
nodes.description: Raw streaming output from the Language Model client, containing incremental tokens or partial responses.

nodes.label: Process Field-Specific Streams
nodes.title: StreamListener
nodes.description: A configurable listener that captures and processes streaming chunks for a specific output field of a DSPy predictor, handling different adapter types (Chat, JSON, XML).

nodes.label: Convert Async to Sync Stream
nodes.title: sync_streamer
nodes.description: Adapts an asynchronous streaming generator, produced by the streaming wrapper, into a synchronous one for easier consumption in synchronous contexts.

nodes.label: Format for OpenAI API Response
nodes.title: streaming_response
nodes.description: Converts a DSPy program's output stream into an OpenAI-compatible server-sent events (SSE) format, suitable for API responses to streaming requests.

nodes.label: API Consumer
nodes.title: External API Consumer
nodes.description: An external client or service that consumes the streaming output, either in synchronous or OpenAI-compatible SSE format.

nodes.label: DSPy Core Dependencies
nodes.title: DSPy Core
nodes.description: Core DSPy components like Modules, Predictions, Signatures, and global settings used by the streaming logic for program execution and configuration.

nodes.label: Async/Sync Utilities
nodes.title: DSPy Async/Sync Utils
nodes.description: General utilities from DSPy for managing asynchronous and synchronous execution flows, such as asyncify and apply_sync_streaming.

nodes.label: JSON Parsing Library
nodes.title: External JSON Parser
nodes.description: An external library (e.g., jiter) used for efficient partial JSON parsing during stream content processing by listeners.

nodes.label: Run Async in New Event Loop
nodes.title: run_in_new_loop
nodes.description: Executes an asynchronous function within a newly created event loop, useful for managing async operations in different contexts or bridging sync/async gaps.

edges.label: Provides async generator for sync conversion
Provides async generator for API formatting

groups.label: Core Streaming Interface
groups.title: Core Streaming Interface
groups.description: Components responsible for exposing and managing the primary streaming functionality to users.

groups.label: Stream Content Management
groups.title: Stream Content Management
groups.description: Components dedicated to analyzing, filtering, and processing the raw stream content based on specific criteria.

groups.label: Output Adapters
groups.title: Output Adapters
groups.description: Components that transform the processed stream data into specific external formats, such as OpenAI-compatible responses.

groups.label: Internal Async Utilities
groups.title: Internal Async Utilities
groups.description: Helper components that provide foundational asynchronous capabilities and context management for the streaming module.
